analyticalQuestion: Does the complete heat-weighted coefficient for the explicit 0100 periodic packet have a nonzero projection onto the dominant affine-block eigenmode?

supportedClaim: Exact affine-branch arithmetic and strict outward intervals prove S_r=C_* lambda^r+O(r 16^r), where 25.1515893341015<lambda<25.1515893341016 and -2.304456798896e-5<C_*<-2.286527505484e-5. Therefore |S_r|/16^r tends to infinity for this explicit quartic packet. Higher Picard orders and the full mild solution are not controlled.
